_about: Every interactive thing in the game. kind = one of the six kinds from The living map. New things are a new entry here, no code. Sizes in metres, mass in kg, speeds in m/s.

kinds.prop: Physics prop: pushed, stacked, toppled, rolled.
kinds.machine: Machine or switch: changes the room for everyone.
kinds.ride: Ride: fast, wobbly, hard to steer.
kinds.hide: Hiding spot: breaks line of sight, lets suspicion drain.
kinds.disguise: Disguise prop: held in your hands to blend in.
kinds.food: Food or throwable: splats, stains, slips.

tin.name: Tin of beans
tin.funny: Topple a tin pyramid onto a queue.
tin.useful: A falling tin is a noise that pulls a guard away from the door.

box.name: Cardboard box
box.funny: Stack boxes into a wobbly ramp and skid off it.
box.useful: Block a door or build a ramp to a high shelf.
box.reaction: The shelf stacker sighs and restacks them.

light_switch.name: Light switch
light_switch.useful: Darkness to sneak past the tills.

trolley.name: Shopping trolley
trolley.funny: Trolley race straight through the checkout queue.

big_box.name: Big delivery box
big_box.funny: A box that tiptoes when nobody is looking.
big_box.useful: Lose a chase and let the "?" meters drain.
big_box.reaction: The guard pokes it, shrugs and walks on.

mop.name: Mop
mop.funny: Wave a mop at the guard and stroll past.

cream_cake.name: Cream cake
cream_cake.useful: The splat leaves a slippery patch behind you.

ball.name: Melon
ball.funny: Bowl a melon into a tin pyramid.
ball.useful: Rolls round corners: a noise you can send somewhere else.
